title: 14-BCV-017 - EnerGuide Rating System for new homes
jurisdiction: Alberta (province-wide, as stated by the STANDATA)
catalogue_status: Catalogue row is not marked [WITHDRAWN]; PDF carries an Archived watermark.

facts.text: The STANDATA recognizes EnerGuide Rating System version 15 as a path associated with ABC 2014 Subsection 9.36.5 for specified house types.

It states at least 5% annual energy savings over the ERS v15 reference case, restricts eligible types, bars counting on-site renewables in savings, bars reduction of process/plug loads, and lists documents due before occupancy.

limitations: This is a provincial regulator-issued STANDATA/standing variance, not an individual application, applicant statement, project drawing, permit record or site-specific decision.
The records address the Alberta Building Code 2014 and, where noted, Alberta Fire Code 2014; do not treat them as proof of applicability under the Alberta 2023 code edition or current law.
